issues.detail: The candidate marks requireCurrentSpaceUser, resolveSpaceMemberResource, and requireSpaceAdministrator as unread source gaps even though the packet includes decisive helper evidence at server/api/v1/space_service.go:19-27, 54-55, and 632-662.
Deployment unverified is reasonable as a deployment limit, but the source-gap unknown is avoidable and should not be presented as unresolved.

sourceSupport.detail: requireCurrentSpaceUser fetches the current user and rejects nil user as unauthenticated.
resolveSpaceMemberResource parses the resource, resolves caller membership, normal target user, and active target membership.
The handler branches on self versus non-self and passes resolved IDs plus currentUser.ID to the store.

rationale: Substantive behavior, branches, bindings, effects, and v1 policy comparison are correct. Evidence is only partial because the candidate unnecessarily leaves available decisive helper implementations unresolved.
